Measured against PyPDF2 (extracted text compared char for char): reportlab Helvetica / Times (3 pages) /
Courier two-column / Arial and Calibri TrueType subsets with accents and ligatures / Tw+leading spacing, and
Edge "print to PDF" (Skia, Type0 Identity-H) for a simple CV, a two-column flex layout, a 3-page justified
document, CJK/RTL/emoji, and tables/links/tiny/letter-spaced text: 11 of 11 identical. Corrupt input fails the
same way (HTTP 500) in both. Not covered: real CVs from Word/LibreOffice/Canva, scanned (image-only) PDFs,
